text:
Rae (CS): Alert - a group of private/onboarding tenants are seeing embedding index failures and stuck progress after overnight maintenance. Need an embargoed customer status + per-tenant ETA for high-touch.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-612 created 1 - bridge https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-612. Severity: high.

Igor (SRE): Quick technical: a background checkpoint compaction job truncated some index checkpoints on the ingestion workers due to an edge case with duplicate document IDs. That left jobs in a conflict state where replays fail. We've paused compaction, restored checkpoints from last consistent snapshot, and prevented replays from touching conflicting ranges.

Nadia (Eng): We've implemented a guarded reprocess mode that skips conflicting doc ranges and writes a reconcile marker; that prevents the replay loop. Reprocess started 04:08 UTC. Estimated: ~70% auto-recover, ~30% need targeted reconcile and manual resume. Bulk reconcile tool in testing, ETA ~2 hours for run across affected tenants.

Rae (CS): Can we get a per-tenant ETA snapshot and a simple sentence I can send to high-touch customers? Also need suggested compensation language and office hours timing.

Igor (SRE): Uploaded per-tenant CSV to /shared/cs/checkpoint-reconcile-affected.csv. Sample ETAs: tenant-orchid ~25m, tenant-nimbus reconcile queued ~50m, tenant-cobalt manual resume ~3h. I'll update CSV every 30m.

Felix (SE): Customer-facing short blurb: 'We're investigating an issue impacting embedding indexing activity for some private/onboarding customers after a maintenance task. Engineering has restored stable checkpoints and is reprocessing jobs. Most tenants should see recovery within 3 hours; your CS rep will provide a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Add: 'No raw files or model weights were exposed or deleted.'

Nadia (Eng): Confirmed - no data loss or exposure. Full technical timeline + RCA will be shared after reconcile completes.

Rae (CS): Draft compensation proposal: opt-in 'one-week dedicated-capacity credit' OR 'one-time $600 onboarding credit' for materially affected customers. Sam - approve?

Sam (CS Manager): Approved. Also recommend offering an expedited onboarding session (1:1) for any customer who opts in to the credit. Schedule office hours today 5-7pm PT for troubleshooting and feedback capture. Flag any renewal-risk customers for immediate GTM outreach.

Felix (SE): Support template for Zendesk (uploaded /shared/cs/templates/checkpoint-reconcile-incident.txt): 'We are aware of an indexing interruption after a maintenance compaction job. Engineering restored stable checkpoints and reprocessing is underway. Expected recovery: <ETA>. If your tenant remains stuck after <threshold>, run the diagnostic below and include the job ids when opening a ticket.'

Felix (SE): Diagnostic command to share with customers: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/index/status
# returns: {"state":"processing|conflict|reconciled","last_error":"...","stuck_ranges":[...],"job_ids":[...]} ```

Igor (SRE): Note for CS: if state == "conflict" include stuck_ranges in the ticket; we can target reconcile for those ranges faster.

Rae (CS): Priors: I'll prepare the embargoed email + Slack DM variants and attach the CSV with per-tenant ETAs. Felix - please add FR/ES translations to /shared/cs/i18n.

Felix (SE): On it. I'll drop short DM variants and translations in ~20m.

Nadia (Eng): We're monitoring reprocess progress and will publish a recovery dashboard link in the CSV. Full RCA timeline to follow.

Rae (CS): Sending priority outreach in 15m after I attach ETAs. Will post final sent copy and list of tenants reached here. Also will capture feedback during office hours and append notes to the CSV. Thanks everyone :heart:
